title: aquilegia vulgaris var. viscosa
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris var. viscosa, commonly known as the sticky or viscid monk's hood, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its use as an anti-inflammatory. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia vulgaris var. viscosa include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
